parent_objective: design terminal-margin retention for fragile closed-loop proof rows

public_gates: design a terminal-margin retention objective or harness
include M183/M170 row16 as a hard retention row
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M274
do not run a new actor update before the retention design is validated
do not use hidden params or privileged actor inputs
hypothesis: Adding an explicit terminal-margin retention layer for fragile closed-loop rows can prevent M271-style objective improvements from crossing near-zero normal-history clearance margins.
success_criteria: specify how terminal-margin rows are represented and weighted
define the loss or gate that protects near-zero normal-history margins
identify required code changes or explain why existing tools are sufficient
pre-register the first guarded actor-update attempt that uses the retention layer
failure_criteria: retention design only anchors first actions and ignores terminal margin
design permits a candidate that fails M183/M170 row16
PPO or actor update is run before design validation

commands.name: m274_design
commands.command: Design terminal-margin retention from M273 evidence before any new update.

results.differentiable_proxy: trajectory action anchor with inverse-margin fragile-row weights

decision_rule: M274 completes the design and admits only a surface-export implementation next. No actor update or PPO should run until the fragile-row registry and terminal-margin trajectory anchors are exported and validated.
